comments.body:
Implementation complete in worktree fix-3ff9; RED->GREEN per plan.

RED: tests/unit/test_push_expected_contention_quiet.py failed 5/7 on unfixed code for the pinned reasons (WARNING at push.py:323 terminal-after-recovery with raw "! [rejected]" stderr and the "..HEAD" suffix; recovery-leg transport notices at WARNING; backlog_grew absent; strict message pinned old wording).

GREEN (all changes logging/wording only - no behavior, classification, retry, or marker change):
- push_state.unpushed_summary now reads "(N unpushed commits on the local tickets branch ahead of origin/tickets; committed locally, they publish on the next successful push)" - names the branch, no bare ..HEAD, self-healing contract in-text.
- push_state.backlog_grew reads the PREVIOUS marker's unpushed count (state the marker already stored) before record_failure overwrites it; ambiguity resolves to False.
- push_classify._terminal_severity: WARNING only for a policy decline in the terminal stderr or a PROVEN-growing backlog (suffix gains "the backlog GREW since the previous failure"); otherwise INFO with "expected under concurrent tickets writers - no action needed".
- push.py: both terminal contention sites (retry-exhausted "failed after N retries" and "terminal push failed after recovery") now logger.log at that severity; both pinned literals appended-to, never reworded - epoch-guard negative assertions honored, not retargeted.
- Mid-retry transient-transport notices demoted to INFO at all three sites (push_classify._retry_transport_or_stop, push_recovery fetch-leg and merge-leg), wording "retrying automatically, no action needed".
- Consciously retargeted pins in the same change: test_push_strict.py (capture at INFO + level assertion), test_push_strict_happy.py and test_push_rejection_surfacing.py (new summary wording).

Verification: new suite 7/7; targeted push/epoch-guard selection 107 passed with ONE failure - test_inline_write_push::test_a_write_pushing_to_the_origin_leaves_no_detached_upkeep - proven PRE-EXISTING: reproduced 2/2 on unmodified origin/main (a1a6a151bc) with baseline sources, passes alone and in all probed pairs. Filed as hypodermal-cacotopic-zenaida (d720-fc72-3763-4cac), linked discovered_from. make lint PASS; make typecheck PASS; complexity ratchet: new=0 increased=0 stale=1 (a function got simpler - sanctioned, baseline untouched).

Next: commit with rebar-ticket trailer + DCO, push gerrit HEAD:refs/for/main, wait LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, Submit, then close.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

Best-effort tickets-branch push failures that are EXPECTED and AUTO-HANDLED are surfaced to
agent-visible stderr at WARNING with wording that primes LLM agent sessions to assume the store
is broken and burn tokens investigating. Two independent session reports on 2026-08-21 (multi-
agent burst, ~12 concurrent writers) show agents halting work to inspect `push.py`, hand-invoke
`commit_and_push_tickets_branch`, and reason about ref topology — for a state that heals on the
next successful write. Operator ruling (2026-08-21): "If these issues are expected and handled
automatically, we need to stop surfacing them to sessions because it primes them to assume
there's an issue and burn tokens investigating."

## Offending messages (all logger.warning, agent-visible)

1. `push.py:342` — "tickets branch push failed after 3 retries: <raw git stderr><suffix>" after
   losing a CONTENTION race; raw git stderr pattern-matches corruption to an LLM (`unable to
   update local ref`, `! [rejected]`). The sibling terminal site `push.py:323` "terminal push
   failed after recovery" is the same lost-contention outcome and gets the same treatment.
2. `push_classify.py:225` — "tickets branch push hit a transient transport fault (attempt x/y),
   retrying" — the code is already retrying itself; WARNING is pure worry-bait (INFO material).
3. `push_state.py:148` `unpushed_summary` — the "(N unpushed commits on origin/tickets..HEAD)"
   suffix: "HEAD" is the TRACKER's HEAD but a session reads it as its code worktree HEAD; the
   count escalates across ALL concurrent sessions; nothing states the self-healing contract.

## What must STAY loud (bug 2a76's rationale is still valid)

- Policy declines (hook declined, GH013, branch protection) — permanent, operator-actionable.
- Strict-mode callers — PushDeliveryError already raises; unchanged.
- A PERSISTENT/growing backlog — fsck PUSH_PENDING and the durable rebar-push-pending marker
  are the operator channels; a terminal failure with a GROWING count may stay WARNING.

## Approach

Logging/wording only — no change to push behavior, classification, retries, or the durable
marker. Encode expected-and-self-healing vs operator-actionable at the existing reporting seam
(`push_classify`, the "how is a failure reported" module):

1. Reword `push_state.unpushed_summary` to name the tickets branch explicitly (no bare
   `..HEAD`) and state the self-healing contract in the text: the commits are committed
   locally and publish on the next successful push. The suffix is shared by every backlog
   message (including the strict `PushDeliveryError` text), so it stays factual for policy
   declines too — the "expected under concurrent writers; no action needed" clause is
   appended only on the demoted expected path (point 3).
2. Add `push_state.backlog_grew(tracker, remote_ref)` — a read-only helper comparing the
   current `unpushed_count` against the `unpushed` count already recorded in the previous
   push-pending marker (state the marker already stores; no new persistent state). Ambiguity
   (no prior marker, non-numeric counts) resolves to False — growth must be PROVEN before a
   report escalates to operator-loud.
3. Add a `push_classify` helper returning (log level, backlog suffix) for a terminal
   best-effort push failure: WARNING for a policy decline in the terminal stderr or a
   proven-growing backlog; otherwise INFO with the appended "expected under concurrent
   tickets writers — no action needed" clause. Called BEFORE `_raise_if_strict` records the
   new marker (which overwrites the previous count the growth check reads).
4. Switch the two terminal lost-contention sites in `push.py` (retry-exhausted ~342 and
   terminal-after-recovery ~323) from `logger.warning` to `logger.log(level, ...)` using that
   helper. The pinned literals "failed after %s retries" and "terminal push failed after
   recovery" are appended-to, never reworded — the epoch-guard negative assertions
   (test_epoch_guard_matrix / test_epoch_guard_reconciliation) are honored, not retargeted.
5. Demote every mid-retry transient-transport notice from WARNING to INFO, wording stating
   the retry is automatic and needs no action: `_retry_transport_or_stop` in `push_classify`
   plus the same-class recovery-leg notices in `push_recovery.py` (merge-leg ~:293, fetch-leg
   ~:378). The TERMINAL transport/policy warnings stay WARNING (bug 2a76 / f61c rationale).

Tests pinning the old wording/level are consciously retargeted in the same change:
`test_push_strict.py` (mid-retry capture level), `test_push_strict_happy.py` and
`test_push_rejection_surfacing.py` (the "unpushed commits on origin/tickets..HEAD" suffix).

## Scope

- src/rebar/_store/push_state.py — `unpushed_summary` rewording; new `backlog_grew` helper.
- src/rebar/_store/push_classify.py — mid-retry demotion to INFO; new terminal-severity helper.
- src/rebar/_store/push_recovery.py — demote the merge-leg and fetch-leg mid-retry
  transient-transport notices to INFO (same class, same wording contract).
- src/rebar/_store/push.py — the two terminal contention log sites call the helper and log at
  its level (message literals appended-to only).
- tests/unit/test_push_expected_contention_quiet.py — NEW: expected-case silence at WARNING +
  worry-free wording + growing-backlog escalation + no bare `..HEAD`.
- tests/unit/test_push_strict.py, tests/unit/test_push_strict_happy.py,
  tests/unit/test_push_rejection_surfacing.py — retarget the pinned wording/level assertions.

## Testing

RED→GREEN (the new tests fail on current main, pass after the fix), all caplog-level
assertions on the `rebar._store` loggers:

- Expected case: a retry-exhausted lost contention race (every push non-fast-forward-rejected,
  recovery merges clean, no prior marker) emits NO record at WARNING or above; an INFO record
  carries "failed after N retries", names the tickets branch, and states "expected under
  concurrent" + "no action needed"; no message contains bare `..HEAD`.
- Mid-retry transient transport notice is captured at INFO, not WARNING.
- Growing backlog: with a prior marker recording a smaller `unpushed` count, the same terminal
  contention failure logs at WARNING (the sanctioned escalation).
- Preserved loud cases: the existing real-git policy-decline suite
  (test_push_rejection_surfacing) still passes at WARNING with reason + backlog count; strict
  callers still raise PushDeliveryError (test_push_strict / test_push_strict_happy).

Verification commands: targeted pytest on the push/epoch-guard suites
(tests/unit/test_push_*.py, tests/unit/test_epoch_guard_matrix.py,
tests/integration/test_epoch_guard_reconciliation.py, tests/unit/test_commit_and_push*,
tests/interfaces/store/test_fsck_push_pending.py), then `make lint` and `make typecheck`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A lost contention race on a best-effort write emits no WARNING-level message, while the
      state remains observable via push_status()/fsck PUSH_PENDING/marker. Checked by the new
      caplog test (no records >= WARNING) plus the existing marker/fsck suites staying green.
- [ ] Mid-retry transient transport messages are INFO or below. Checked by caplog level
      assertions in test_push_strict.py and the new suite.
- [ ] Every remaining backlog message names the tickets branch explicitly (no bare `..HEAD`),
      with the self-healing contract stated in the message text. Checked by wording assertions
      on the emitted records and the retargeted strict-message pins.
- [ ] Policy declines and strict failures remain WARNING/raise, byte-compatible where tests
      pin them (reason token, GH013 passthrough, backlog count). Checked by
      test_push_rejection_surfacing and test_push_strict staying green.
- [ ] Tests pin expected-case silence at WARNING, worry-free wording, plus the preserved loud
      cases. Checked by the new test module failing RED on unfixed main and passing GREEN.

demote mid-retry transport notice to INFO; add terminal-severity helper
demote merge-leg and fetch-leg mid-retry transport notices to INFO
terminal contention log sites log at the computed level (appended-to literals only)
new RED->GREEN tests: expected-case silence at WARNING, wording contract, growing-backlog escalation
retarget mid-retry level capture to INFO
